     needs, in one screen (≤ 3,000 characters above the fold). Logs, traces and long evidence go
     inside <details> — they are exempt from the budget.
     This is the org base. A repository with its own build bot or test gates carries a tailored copy
     (e.g. cubecmp adds `QA-Verify:`); the section skeleton is the same. -->

## Summary

<!-- ≤ 5 lines in your own words: what changed and why. Narrating the diff is noise — the diff is right there. -->

## Closes

Closes #

## QA

QA-Status:
